entries.notes: Selected the confirmatory three-factor TAS-20 solution because the exploratory analysis was described but did not report item-level loadings. F1 maps to Factor 1 Difficulty Identifying Feelings, F2 to Factor 2 Difficulty Describing Feelings, and F3 to Factor 3 Externally-Oriented Thinking. The CFA specified each item as measuring a single latent factor; non-target item-factor parameters were not printed and were coded null rather than inferred as zero. Item 10 loading 2.08 and item 15 loading -0.029 were recorded exactly as printed. Age was reported for the initially recruited 390 students, while final analytic n was 383 after excluding seven cases with missing data.
